terms.title: Intego
terms.body: Iyi nyandiko yerekana imiterere y’agateganyo y’amategeko yo gukoresha AWA.

terms.title: Gukoresha porogaramu
terms.body: AWA itanga ibikoresho vyo kwikurikirana no kwita ku mererwe myiza. Ibikubiyemwo bya nyuma bisobanura uburenganzira n’inshingano vy’abakoresha bizongerwamwo igihe ubwemeranya bw’amategeko buzoba burangiye.

terms.title: Kuboneka kwa serivisi
terms.body: Amategeko ya nyuma agenga kuboneka, gukorerwa no guhinduka kwa serivisi aracari gutegerezwa kwemezwa.

terms.title: Kuvugana natwe
terms.body: Amakuru yemewe yo kuvugana natwe azongerwamwo igihe itsinda rya AWA rizoba ryayemeje.

privacy.title: Amakuru yerekeye
privacy.body: Iki gice kizosobanura neza amakuru atunganywa na AWA n’impamvu yabyo, igihe ubwemeranya bw’amategeko buzoba burangiye.

privacy.title: Kubika n’umutekano
privacy.body: Inyandiko ya nyuma izosobanura ingingo zo kubika, uburyo bwo kurinda n’igihe amakuru abikwa.

privacy.title: Uburenganzira bwawe
privacy.body: Uburyo bwo kugera ku makuru yawe, kuyakosora canke kuyasiba buzosobanurwa muri verisiyo yemejwe.

privacy.title: Kuvugana ku buzima bwite
privacy.body: Aderese yemewe yo kuvugana n’ushinzwe ubuzima bwite izongerwamwo imbere yo gutangazwa.

imageAlts: Ishusho: muganga n’umugore w’imbuto mu isuzuma bakoresha ultrasound. Inyandiko: Ubuvuzi mu gihe c’inda, ku buzima bwa mama no ku mererwe myiza y’umwana.
Ishusho: umugore w’imbuto yaguramwo umubiri ku mukeka wa yoga. Inyandiko: Genda kugira inda ibe nziza. Icapa: mama w’amagara mazima ku mwana akura neza.
